summary: Phase 146N independently reconstructed Chapter 146 (146A through 146M, including 146E-146H.3V, 146J, 146K, 146L, 146LV) as a whole chapter from primary sources -- the frozen CHGR-001 v1.3 contract text, production implementation, current tests, and git history -- treating no predecessor phase's own report text as proof. Resolved a Phase 146M attribution-gate discrepancy: .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json recorded a stale phase_commits=[PENDING]/pushed_status=pending for Phase 146M despite commit d743eba4 being unambiguously the pushed tip of main/origin/main/origin/HEAD, containing Phase 146M's complete canonical evidence set. Corrected as a narrowly-scoped, disclosed governance-bookkeeping-only correction (commit 37e1d32f); no substantive Phase 146M finding, verdict, or report content was altered. Independently reconfirmed both of Phase 146I's original Blocking findings (A: duplicate-related-artifact first-match ambiguity; C: confirmation/provenance cross-artifact digest-reference bypass) remain closed via fresh adversarial spot checks against two newly-constructed, live, CLI-published genuine bundles (not reused fixtures, not 146M's own bundles): confirmation/provenance/integrity cross-bundle substitution rejected (REFERENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH / DIGEST_MISMATCH via the reciprocal payload_digest binding); duplicate confirmation rejected RELATED_ARTIFACT_AMBIGUOUS in both argument orders; tampered duplicate rejected identically; reordered full valid set still verified; primary-record tamper rejected DIGEST_MISMATCH with no repair side-effect on re-verification of the restored original. Independently built a wheel in a freshly-provisioned isolated virtual environment, confirmed all 15 CHGR schema resource files package correctly, and confirmed a separate fresh installed-only venv (no source tree on the Python path) operates fully offline and agrees materially with source-tree behavior for both inspect and verify. Regression executed fresh by this phase: 223/223 targeted CHGR/publication tests passed; fast_green 4391/4391 passed; broad keyword sweep 4041 passed/10 failed/4 skipped, all 10 failures independently reproduced and reclassified (python -m build environment-provisioning gap, reproduced directly; one non-reproducible, non-CHGR test-order flake, reproduced passing in isolation). No new Blocking finding was discovered by this phase. Verdict: CHAPTER CERTIFIED WITH OBSERVATIONS, naming explicitly: the corrected attribution bookkeeping; a newly-surfaced carry-forward gap where Phase 146M's own remaining-findings ledger did not restate Phase 146I's Finding E (stale chgr/README.md disclosure text describing production create/confirm/publish commands and .pcae storage as 'not implemented', which they now are); a terminology-precision note that six defined phrases named in this phase's own governing instruction do not appear verbatim in CHGR-001 (the contract uses closely related but not identical field-level phrasing); and the still-unremoved but harmless inspection.py dead SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION constant -- none individually or in combination Blocking. This certification does not authorize runtime execution, autonomous authority, policy change, strategic-lineage change, or expansion beyond Observed/observe/unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_146N_CHGR001_SCHEMA_ENVELOPE_CHAPTER_CERTIFICATION.md.
